attributes.name: video_presentation_method
attributes.definition: How a video is represented on the page when shown as a poster/preview rather than an embedded playing video.

values.definition: A flat image of a video frame, with player UI/title baked into the picture.
A styled placeholder block (gradient/solid) with a separate play icon overlay, no real video frame.
A real working video player or iframe embed.

attributes.name: video_alt_text
attributes.definition: Accessibility text treatment of the video thumbnail or placeholder image.

values.definition: Alt attribute is present but empty.
Alt text describes the video or its title.
Alt text treatment is not stated or not applicable.

attributes.name: play_control_rendering
attributes.definition: How the play button/controls are rendered.

values.definition: Player controls are part of the raster image.
A distinct circular/translucent play icon layered over the thumbnail via markup/CSS.
